claim_traces.claim_text: "mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA."
reasoning_steps: mRNA COVID-19 vaccines do not alter, integrate into, or permanently change human DNA
Scientifically, mRNA functions in the cytoplasm and does not enter the cell's nucleus, where genomic DNA resides
Furthermore, mRNA lacks the reverse transcriptase enzymes required to convert RNA into DNA, and human cells rapidly degrade the vaccine mRNA after translating it into the target spike protein
Health authorities worldwide (including the CDC, WHO, and FDA) and scientific consensus firmly confirm that mRNA vaccines cannot modify human genetics [1][3][4][5][6].

claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short at around 5 feet 2 inches is a well-known historical misconception
At his autopsy in 1821, Napoleon's height was recorded as 5 pieds 2 pouces (French feet and inches)

Because the pre-metric French inch (*pouce*) was longer than the British inch (approximately 2.7 cm versus 2.54 cm), his measurement translates to approximately 5 feet 5.5 inches to 5 feet 7 inches (around 1.67–1.69 meters) in modern/English units
This placed him at average or even slightly above-average height for an adult French male of the late 18th and early 19th centuries
The perception that he was exceptionally diminutive was largely fueled by direct translation confusion and contemporary British wartime propaganda (such as caricatures by James Gillray).
